terra.problem: The line says foreign kings passed judgment on the last kings of Judah at Riblah, but the passages describe judgment on Zedekiah only. They say Neco imprisoned Jehoahaz, not that he judged him.
Some wording may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader, especially “levy,” “Chaldeans,” “judgment was pronounced,” and “exile.” Use simpler words or brief explanations.
